name: Habit Tracker
tagline: Log it. Count it. Remember it.
summary: Create your own topics, tick them on a calendar, and see how often each one happened this month, in 3 months, or this year.

features.title: Your own topics
features.text: Make a topic for anything — gym, office days, calls home. Pick a name, colour and icon.

features.title: Tap a day, add a topic
features.text: Add one day or a whole date range in one go, like “Office, 1–3 Oct”.

features.title: Plan, then tick off
features.text: Entries are planned or done. One tap switches between them.

features.title: Counts that add up
features.text: See totals for this month, the last 3 months, this year or a custom range.

features.title: Topic history
features.text: Open a topic to see every date it happened, newest first, with your notes.

features.title: Your data, your copy
features.text: Export to CSV or JSON and import a backup whenever you like.

faq.q: How do I add a topic to several days at once?
faq.a: Tap a day, pick the topic, then switch to **Date range** and choose the last day. “Office, 1–3 Oct” makes three entries in one go.

faq.q: How do I back up my data?
faq.a: Go to **Settings → Backup** and export to CSV or JSON. Keep the file somewhere safe, like your email or cloud drive.

faq.q: Will I lose my data if I change phones?
faq.a: Your data lives only on your phone. Export a JSON backup on the old phone and import it on the new one from **Settings → Backup**.
Check that notifications are allowed for Habit Tracker in **Android Settings → Apps → Habit Tracker → Notifications**, and that battery saver isn’t stopping the app.

faq.q: How do I turn off anonymous stats?
faq.a: Go to **Settings → Privacy & analytics** and turn it off. Collection stops straight away.

termsNotes: Everything you log stays on your device. You are responsible for keeping your own backups.
